name: catchgrid-pokemon-go-companion
description: A visual, Cloudflare-native Pokemon GO collection companion.

scripts.build: pnpm run cf-typegen && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run release:preflight && pnpm run release:bookmark:production && pnpm run release:migrate:production && pnpm run release:deploy:production && pnpm run release:smoke:production
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:worker
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.release:preflight: pnpm run check && pnpm run catalog:verify && pnpm run test:e2e && wrangler deploy --dry-run --strict
scripts.release:deploy:production: pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --strict --message CatchGrid-production-release
scripts.release:smoke:production: node --input-type=module -e "const base=process.argv[1];for(const [method,path] of [['GET','/api/health'],['HEAD','/api/health'],['GET','/api/ready'],['HEAD','/api/ready'],['GET','/api/v1/catalog/version'],['HEAD','/api/v1/catalog/version'],['GET','/api/v1/catalog'],['HEAD','/api/v1/catalog'],['GET','/manifest.webmanifest'],['GET','/robots.txt']]){const response=await fetch(base+path,{method});if(!response.ok)throw new Error(method+' '+path+' returned '+response.status)}const health=await(await fetch(base+'/api/health')).json();if(!health.gitSha||health.gitSha==='unknown'||health.gitSha==='development')throw new Error('Release Git SHA is missing');console.log(JSON.stringify({ok:true,gitSha:health.gitSha,workerVersionId:health.workerVersionId}))" https://dex.cjdev.app
